description: NaNbGeO₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.59 Å. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 37°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.83-2.23 Å. Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-56°. There are three shorter (1.77 Å) and one longer (1.78 Å) Ge-O bond length. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Nb, and one Ge atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₂NbGe tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Ge atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Ge atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Ge atom.
